title: Long Rebound Chase and Secure
description: A coach deliberately shoots long misses that bounce away from the rim, training players to track and secure rebounds that don't come down easily.

content.objective: Track the ball off a long miss and sprint to secure it before it rolls away.
content.setup: A coach deliberately shoots long, off-target misses from the free-throw line.
instructions: The coach shoots a shot intended to bounce long off the rim.
The rebounder tracks the flight and sprints to get in front of the bounce.
Secure the ball with two hands and pivot away from pressure immediately.
coachingPoints: Read the angle of the miss early, don't wait to react.
Sprint through the rebound rather than drifting toward it.
Secure with two hands even on an awkward bounce.
commonMistakes: Standing under the rim and hoping the ball comes to you.
Reaching with one hand on a bouncing ball instead of using two.
Releasing the box-out position too early to chase the ball.
content.safety: Watch for other players when chasing a long rebound at speed.
